doc:
Profile module for the MySocial network
 Handles user identity, profile creation, management, and username registration

bootstrap_init.doc: Bootstrap initialization function - creates the username registry and treasury

is_reserved_name.doc: Check if a name is reserved and cannot be registered

to_lowercase_bytes.doc: Convert a byte vector to lowercase

to_lowercase_byte.doc: Convert a single ASCII byte to lowercase

canonical_registry_username.doc:
Canonical username for [`UsernameRegistry`] keys.
 Folds ASCII `A–Z` to `a–z` only; does not apply Unicode case folding.

ascii_to_string.doc: Convert an ASCII String to a String

canonical_registry_username_from_bytes.doc: Canonical username for [`UsernameRegistry`] keys (package helper for PoC beneficiary flows).

lock_username_for_beneficiary.doc: Lock a username while an ACTIVE PoC username beneficiary provision exists.

unlock_username_for_beneficiary.doc: Release a username beneficiary lock after claim or admin end.

create_profile.doc:
Create a new profile with a required username
 Main entry: also creates a linked [`memory::MemoryAccount`] shared object.

create_profile_from_beneficiary_claim.doc: Create a profile from an oracle-verified PoC username beneficiary claim.

ensure_memory_account.doc:
Backfill a Memory account for profiles created before Memory integration, or test-only paths.
 Transfers the same `Profile` back to the caller.

transfer_profile.doc:
Transfer profile when there is **no** linked Memory account (`memory_account_id` is `None`).
 Profiles created via [`create_profile`] have a Memory link — use [`transfer_profile_with_memory`].

transfer_profile_with_memory.doc: Same as [`transfer_profile`], but keeps [`memory::MemoryRegistry`] and linked [`memory::MemoryAccount`] in sync.

update_profile.doc: Only the profile owner can update profile information

display_name.doc: Get the display name of a profile

bio.doc: Get the bio of a profile

profile_picture.doc: Get the profile picture URL of a profile

cover_photo.doc: Get the cover photo URL of a profile

owner.doc: Get the owner of a profile

id.doc: Get the ID of a profile

lookup_profile_by_username.doc: Lookup profile ID by username in the registry

is_username_beneficiary_locked.doc:
True when the canonical username is not currently claimed
 Returns true when username is locked for an ACTIVE PoC username beneficiary provision.

lookup_profile_by_owner.doc: Lookup profile ID by owner address

get_id_address.doc: Get the ID address of a profile

get_owner.doc: Get the owner of a profile

create_subscription_service.doc: Create a subscription service for this profile (creates separate service object)

has_valid_subscription.doc: Check if a viewer has a valid subscription (uses subscription module functions)

create_offer.doc:
Create an offer to purchase a profile
 Locks MYSO tokens in the offer

accept_offer.doc: Accept an offer when there is **no** linked Memory account. Use [`accept_offer_with_memory`] for profiles created via [`create_profile`].

accept_offer_with_memory.doc: Same as [`accept_offer`] but synchronizes Memory ownership with the buyer.

reject_or_revoke_offer.doc:
Reject or revoke an offer on a profile
 Can be called by the profile owner to reject or the offeror to revoke
 Returns locked MYSO tokenv s to the offeror

has_offer_from.doc: Check if a profile has an offer from a specific address

has_offers.doc: Check if a profile has any active offers

get_treasury_address.doc: Get the treasury address from the EcosystemTreasury

update_ecosystem_treasury_config.doc: Update Ecosystem Treasury config: treasury address and profile sale fee bps (admin only).

profile_sale_fee_bps.doc: Read the configured profile sale fee (bps).

treasury_version.doc: Get the version of the EcosystemTreasury

create_profile_admin_cap.doc: Create a ProfileAdminCap for bootstrap (package visibility only)

create_ecosystem_treasury_admin_cap.doc:
Create an EcosystemTreasuryAdminCap for bootstrap (package visibility only)
 This function is only callable by other modules in the same package

create_ecosystem_badge_admin_cap.doc: Create an EcosystemBadgeAdminCap for bootstrap (package visibility only)

create_username_admin_cap.doc: Create a UsernameAdminCap for bootstrap (package visibility only)

assign_ecosystem_badge.doc: Assign an ecosystem badge to a profile - called by EcosystemBadgeAdminCap holder

admin_set_profile_x_username.doc: Set or clear a profile X username — only callable by an EcosystemBadgeAdminCap holder.

revoke_ecosystem_badge.doc: Revoke an ecosystem badge from a profile - called by EcosystemBadgeAdminCap holder

admin_revoke_username.doc: Revoke a username — removes claim; username becomes available immediately.

admin_reassign_username.doc: Reassign an existing username to a different profile.

linked_memory_account_id.doc: Linked [`social_contracts::memory::MemoryAccount`] object id (`None` for legacy/shared test profiles).

linked_ai_credit_balance_id.doc: Linked [`social_contracts::ai_credit::AiCreditBalance`] object id (always set for greenfield profiles).

min_offer_amount.doc: Get the minimum offer amount for a profile

x_username.doc: X/Twitter username on the profile (set or cleared only via admin entry).

is_for_sale.doc: Check if a profile is for sale (has a minimum offer amount set)

add_badge_to_profile.doc:
Adds a badge to a profile - called by platform module
 This function trusts the caller has done authorization checks

remove_badge_from_profile.doc:
Removes a badge from a profile - called by platform module
 This function trusts the caller has done authorization checks

remove_own_badge.doc:
Remove a badge from a profile - can be called by profile owner
 Users can delete badges they don't want to display
 Note: Badges are tied to profile identity and cannot be transferred separately

get_profile_badges.doc:
Get all badges associated with a profile
 Returns vector of BadgeData for querying badge information
 Note: Badges are tied to this profile and cannot be transferred to other profiles

has_badge.doc: Check if a profile has a specific badge

get_badge.doc:
Get a specific badge from a profile by badge ID
 Returns BadgeData for querying badge information

get_platform_badges.doc:
Get badges issued by a specific platform
 Returns vector of BadgeData for querying badge information

badge_id.doc:
Count the number of badges a profile has
 Get the badge ID from a ProfileBadge

set_selected_badge.doc:
Set the selected badge to display for a profile (owner only)
 The badge must exist in the profile's badges collection

get_selected_badge_id.doc: Get the selected badge ID for a profile

get_display_badge.doc:
Get the badge that should be displayed for a profile
 Returns the selected badge if one is set, otherwise returns the first badge
 Returns None if the profile has no badges
 Returns BadgeData for querying badge information

clear_selected_badge.doc:
Clear the selected badge (owner only). Clears both platform and ecosystem selection overrides;
 display falls back to first badge per [`get_display_badge`] / [`get_display_ecosystem_badge`].

set_selected_ecosystem_badge.doc:
Set the selected ecosystem badge to display for a profile (owner only)
 The badge must exist and have the ecosystem_badge_ prefix

get_selected_ecosystem_badge_id.doc: Get the selected ecosystem badge ID for a profile

get_display_ecosystem_badge.doc:
Get the ecosystem badge that should be displayed for a profile
 Returns the selected ecosystem badge if one is set, otherwise the first ecosystem badge
 Returns None if the profile has no ecosystem badges

clear_selected_ecosystem_badge.doc: Clear the selected ecosystem badge (owner only)

validate_schedule.doc: Validate schedule pieces and return `schedule_end` (absolute ms timestamp).

continuous_vesting_piece.doc: Build a continuous vesting piece (linear when curve_factor is 0 or 1000).

cliff_lump_piece.doc: Build a cliff lump unlock piece.

vest_myso.doc:
Create a vesting wallet from parallel piece vectors (entry-compatible).
 Cliff lumps unlock instantly at `time_offset`; continuous pieces vest over `duration`.

claim_vested_tokens.doc: Claim vested tokens. Sub-threshold amounts during active vesting are no-ops.

sqrt_approximation.doc: Simple square root approximation using Newton's method

EcosystemTreasuryAdminCap.doc: Admin capability for Ecosystem Treasury management

EcosystemBadgeAdminCap.doc: Admin capability for assigning ecosystem badges to user profiles

UsernameAdminCap.doc: Admin capability for username registry management (reserve, revoke, reassign)

EcosystemTreasury.doc: Social Ecosystem Treasury that receives fees from profile sales

UsernameRegistry.doc: Username Registry — sole on-chain store for username ownership

beneficiary_usernames.doc: Usernames provisioned for PoC username beneficiary vaults (ACTIVE only)

Profile.doc: Profile object that contains user information

min_offer_amount.doc: Minimum offer amount in MYSO tokens the owner is willing to accept (optional)

badges.doc: Collection of badges assigned to the profile

selected_badge_id.doc:
Badge ID of the selected/primary badge to display (optional)
 If None, the first badge in the badges vector should be displayed

selected_ecosystem_badge_id.doc:
Badge ID of the selected ecosystem badge to display (optional)
 If None, the first ecosystem badge in the badges vector should be displayed

memory_account_id.doc: Shared [`memory::MemoryAccount`] object id when linked (`None` until [`profile::ensure_memory_account`] or legacy profiles).

ai_credit_balance_id.doc: Shared [`ai_credit::AiCreditBalance`] object id — always set at profile creation (greenfield).

ProfileBadge.doc:
Profile Badge that can be assigned to profiles by platform admins/moderators
 These badges cannot be transferred, sold, or copied and stay with the profile

badge_id.doc: Unique identifier for the badge (platform ID + badge name)

description.doc: Description of what the badge represents

media_url.doc: Media URL for the badge (can be image, video, etc.)

icon_url.doc: Icon URL for the badge (small icon displayed next to username)

platform_id.doc: ID of the platform that issued the badge

issued_at.doc: Timestamp when the badge was issued

issued_by.doc: Address of the admin/moderator who issued the badge

badge_type.doc: Badge type/tier (1-100), allows for badge hierarchy

BadgeData.doc:
Read-only badge data returned by query functions
 This struct has copy ability to allow returning badge information,
 but the actual ProfileBadge cannot be copied or transferred

VestingPiece.doc: One schedule piece: lump cliff unlock or continuous curved vesting.

time_offset.doc: Milliseconds from `start_time` when this piece activates

duration.doc: 0 for cliff lumps; vest window length for continuous pieces

amount_bps.doc: Share of total_amount in basis points; all pieces sum to 10_000

curve_factor.doc: Curve factor for continuous pieces (1000 = linear)

VestingWallet.doc: Vesting Wallet contains MYSO coins released over a piecewise schedule.

BadgeAssignedEvent.doc: Event emitted when a badge is assigned to a profile

profile_id.doc: ID of the profile receiving the badge

description.doc: Description of what the badge represents

media_url.doc: Media URL for the badge (can be image, video, etc.)

icon_url.doc: Icon URL for the badge (small icon displayed next to username)

platform_id.doc: Platform ID that issued the badge

BadgeRevokedEvent.doc: Event emitted when a badge is revoked from a profile

profile_id.doc: ID of the profile losing the badge

platform_id.doc: Platform ID that issued the badge

BadgeSelectedEvent.doc: Event emitted when a profile owner selects a badge to display

EcosystemBadgeSelectionClearedEvent.doc: Emitted when only ecosystem badge selection is cleared (see [`clear_selected_ecosystem_badge`]).

BadgeRemovedEvent.doc: Event emitted when a profile owner removes their own badge

platform_id.doc: Platform ID that issued the badge

ProfileCreatedEvent.doc: Profile created event (username is emitted via [`UsernameClaimedEvent`])

ProfileUpdatedEvent.doc: Profile updated event with all profile details (username lives in registry)

UsernameClaimedEvent.doc: Emitted when a username is claimed at profile creation

UsernameRevokedEvent.doc: Emitted when an admin revokes a username from a profile

UsernameReassignedEvent.doc: Emitted when an admin reassigns a username to a different profile

ProfileXUsernameUpdatedEvent.doc: X username set or cleared by an EcosystemBadgeAdminCap holder (audit trail).

ProfileOfferCreatedEvent.doc: Event emitted when an offer is created for a profile

ProfileOfferAcceptedEvent.doc: Event emitted when an offer is accepted

ProfileOfferRejectedEvent.doc: Event emitted when an offer is rejected or revoked

ProfileOffer.doc: Represents an offer to purchase a profile

ProfileSaleFeeEvent.doc: Event emitted when a fee is collected from a profile sale

VestingPieceEvent.doc: Copyable piece snapshot for vesting events

TokensVestedEvent.doc: Event emitted when MYSO tokens are vested

TokensClaimedEvent.doc: Event emitted when vested tokens are claimed

VestingWalletDeletedEvent.doc: Event emitted when a vesting wallet is deleted

EcosystemTreasuryUpdatedEvent.doc: Event emitted when Ecosystem Treasury address is updated
